authorization_envelope.goal: Find non-synthetic factor weights and corporate-action-safe prices through every real news event T+1.
scope: Read-only inspection of local multi-factor-alpha-platform artifacts
Read-only inspection of local TDX US day files
Read-only inspection of GitHub releases, Actions runs, and artifact metadata
Fail-closed validation changes inside Evidence-to-Alpha Trading System
non_scope: Modification of multi-factor-alpha-platform or TDX source files
Broker, credential, real-money, merge, or deployment actions
Fabricated factor, price, corporate-action, PB, novelty, or Paper evidence
acceptance: Artifact contents independently reproduce attested coverage dates
Factor weights cover every real event through required T+1 and have PIT universe provenance
Prices expose adjusted close or total-return semantics through required T+1 with split, dividend, special-dividend, and delisting evidence
stop_conditions: Latest real event starts after all available factor and price coverage
Available recent prices are raw close and explicitly not corporate-action safe
No authorized data refresh or licensed adjusted-price source is present

declared_limitations: Dividends and smaller corporate actions remain unadjusted
Universe is current-constituent based and retains survivorship bias
Borrow cost is a proxy and security-level historical availability is absent

verified_facts: All 200 current real-news events start after the latest available V6.5 weights and TDX prices.
The only local price panel with an explicit adj_close field ends on 2024-12-31.
The newer TDX feed is raw close and cannot satisfy the corporate-action-safe price contract.
GitHub contains no release or Actions artifact that closes the market-input gap.
Readiness now recomputes artifact coverage and value-field semantics from CSV or Parquet contents instead of trusting attestation dates alone.
unknowns: No authorized source of PIT universe membership through August 2026 is present.
No licensed or otherwise attested total-return price dataset through August 2026 is present.
No pipeline run manifest binds the untracked V6.5 weight artifact hash to an immutable production run.

decision.reason: Zero real events can have causally valid factor and corporate-action-safe T+1 coverage from the inspected inputs.
required_next_inputs: PIT factor weights and universe membership through at least 2026-08-21
Corporate-action-safe adjusted prices through at least every selected event T+1
Immutable hashes, production provenance, and unresolved-exception attestations for both artifacts
